text: Experts say artificial intelligence will change our lives in big ways. Today we have "narrow AI," which is good at one task, like playing chess. In the future, we may create artificial general intelligence (AGI). AGI would think and learn like a human, and it could do many different jobs. This could bring real benefits, such as better medicine and cleaner energy. However, there are also risks. AGI might take away jobs or be used in dangerous ways. Some people believe AGI will arrive in 20 years, while others think it will take much longer. Nobody knows for sure what will happen.
